I'm on a spot-price electricity contract. Please schedule these appliance cycles for 2023-03-17 so that my electricity cost is as low as possible, without exceeding my household peak load limit:
- dishwasher (dishwasher_1): ready from 07:00, must finish by 20:15
- washing machine (washing_machine_1): ready from 07:00, must finish by 17:00

The estimated cost for this schedule is well within your household limit, ensuring you save on electricity!
